short: The period following the collapse of the Mycenaean palaces, characterized by a lack of written records and simpler material culture.
full: The Greek Dark Ages began with the collapse of the Mycenaean civilization and ended with the rise of the Greek city-states. During this time, the Linear B writing system was lost, and populations declined or moved. However, it was also a time of transformation, setting the stage for the adoption of the Phoenician alphabet and the emergence of the polis.
